{{Quote|They attacked the Czerka, who deployed numerous giant sandcrawlers and started tearing up the desert with ion shovels and whatever else.|A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] on the reasoning for the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] attacks|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''ion shovel''' was a hand tool used for digging. The [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] utilized these while mining on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
